purpose: Sell existing paid inventory; no procurement or pricing recommendations

methodology.unit: exact current positive SKU; source signals can have fragrance-level scope

classes.A: SKU evidence: explicit bestseller/reviews for exact brand/fragrance/format/volume. Source-level A can refer to fragrance generally and is downgraded to SKU B when another/unspecified variant; fragrance_A counted separately.
classes.B: Catalog presence, cross-format inference, manufacturer facts, or supplementary marketplace evidence.
classes.C: No reliable matching signal found in recorded search; never evidence of zero demand.

tier_rules_in_order: identity blocker -> SLOW and promotion blocked
image file and description required for CORE/STRONG/NORMAL
CORE / PRIORITY: at least 2 independent explicit bestseller sources at fragrance level
STRONG: at least 1 independent A source and 2 non-marketplace source groups, OR 2 independent Russian retailer catalogs
NORMAL: at least 1 matched observation and ready card
SLOW: no matched observation or card/identity incomplete
CLEARANCE: not assigned without inventory age/condition, own conversion and margin evidence; count may be zero
methodology.high_stock_rule: stock >= 3 units; 104 of 148 SKUs have stock 1, 35 have stock 2; threshold separates 9 largest SKU holdings
methodology.independence: Country mirrors and brand/distributor networks grouped conservatively; marketplace observations never sole grounds for CORE/STRONG. Manufacturer facts are not independent proof of demand.
methodology.freshness: Live search performed on checked_at; indexed pages can be weeks/months old. No claim of real-time sell-through.
methodology.price_policy: All trade.price null; no legacy or competitor prices exported
methodology.card_quality: Existing description/image presence is presentation readiness, not independent verification of every editorial claim.
